title: SETIsearch V7.0 (Phases D079-D112): 62.58-Octave, 1,083-Star Panchromatic and Multi-Messenger Technosignature Survey — Machine-Readable Catalogs and Companion Archives A-AL
description: Complete archival dataset, AAS/VizieR machine-readable tables (.mrt/.fits/.csv), pure-stdlib verification suites, and 38 prospectively locked Companion Archives (A-AL, 657.49 MiB) for the D079-D112 SETIsearch survey. Covers 1,083 unique targets (787 science [327 exoplanet hosts / 576 planets] + 296 controls; 267 stars within <10 pc at 0.78810 kW median beamed UV-mm sensitivity), 72 spectrographs / 104 spectral arms across 62.582 EM octaves (1.239842e-15 to 8,556.41831 um, including 45.682 unbroken HE octaves up to 1.000 PeV 1LHAASO, INTEGRAL 511 keV, and 10/10 ALMA bands B1-B10), 0.1 TeV-10 PeV IceCube muon neutrinos, IXPE X-ray and optical/NIR Stokes spectropolarimetry, 4,383 exposures (736,410.27 h), and 113,967 synthetic calibration trials with 0 verified ETI detections.
